cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Say You Saw It Too
cards.instruction: Get someone to admit noticing the impossible detail before you reveal how much you believe it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you send the soup back, look properly. I taught you to notice what was on the plate before giving a verdict. Did anything move?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Cold noodles. That's my complaint. What did you see?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your own answer first. Did one of them wave, or am I putting that in your head?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It waved me closer. I'm still not eating it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, you watched before deciding. I've ordered it lunch. Since you aren't eating, ask whether it wants your bread; you remember how we welcome someone to the table.

reason: Make prior teaching determine the response, and distinguish surrendering ordinary explanations from hiding culpability or just redirecting why questions. Repair explicit contradictions and give hope scenes real next steps and visible withholding.
